title: SARATR-X: Toward Building a Foundation Model for SAR Target Recognition
mechanism: SSL foundation model for noisy greyscale SAR on 0.18M unlabelled images, using multi-scale gradient features as masked-modeling targets so the model does not learn speckle.
adaptation: Repeat our closed R34 SparK job with multi-scale gradient / HOG targets instead of normalised pixels; gradient targets keep ridges and edges while ignoring EL sensor noise and source contrast.
min_experiment: Gradient-target MIM (~15 GPU-h) + PF vs pixel-target MIM checkpoint and house PF, 5 v 5; kill if crack IoU < +0.012 and E1 recall < +0.02.
evidence: R: competitive with or better than supervised, semi- and self-supervised methods on few-shot SAR classification and detection.
prior_overlap: Partial: same backbone and pool as our n.d. MIM; only the target changes, which was not tested.
